items.title: DreamX: Video Diffusion Model is a Universal Latent Action Learner

articles.title: DreamX: Video Diffusion Model is a Universal Latent Action Learner
articles.summary: Learning a universal action representation from video requires modeling dynamics that are consistent across different executions of the same action yet invariant to changes in embodiment and appearance. Existing latent action models infer actions from visual transitions, but their representations often entangle the underlying action with irrelevant visual variations, limiting transfer across embodiments. We introduce DreamX, which repurposes a pretrained video diffusion model as a universal latent action learner. Our approach extracts compact latent actions from the video model's rich spatiotemporal features, compressing each latent video frame by $\boldsymbol{300\times}$ ($\boldsymbol{1{,}200 \rightarrow 4}$ tokens). In addition, by leveraging the video model's generative prior, these latent actions capture action-relevant dynamics disentangled from visual appearance. The resulting latent space serves as a shared action interface across embodiments (human and robot), environments, and action parameterizations. editorial.lead:
概述：据 IT之家报道，松下电器机电宣布向 AI 相关业务投入 920 亿日元，涉及多层基板材料、电容器产能和下一代半导体封装材料研发。项目包含分期投产安排，尚不能理解为新增产能已经全部释放。

核心要点：

2. 日本宇治与印尼峇淡的 SP-Cap 电容器项目计划合计投入约 170 亿日元，面向 GPU 等 AI 服务器元件的中长期需求。
3. 四日市的新研发大楼计划投入约 80 亿日元，重点是下一代半导体封装材料；这些均为公司公布的建设和投资计划。
